fullContentHtml:
HSSC CET Group D 2023 Additional Posts Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Haryana Staff Selection Commission (HSSC) has released the Result for the post of Haryana State Common Eligibility Test (CET) Group D. Applications for the HSSC CET Group D Recruitment 2023 were accepted from 05 June 2023 to 26 June 2023. The Examination was Conducted from 21-22 October 2023. Candidates who appeared in this examination can download their HSSC CET Group D 2023 Additional Post Result 2026. which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start : 05 June 2023
  • Last Date : 26 June 2023
  • Last Date Fees Payment : 30 June 2023
  • Admit Card : 17 October 2023
  • Exam Date : 21 to 22 October 2023
  • Download Result : 12 January 2024
  • Download Revised Result : 02 July 2025
  • Additional Posts Result : 26 June 2026

Application Fee

  • With PPP / Aadhaar
  • General (Male) : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, BC, EWS, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • ESM, All Females : Rs. 250/-
  • Without PPP / Aadhaar
  • General (Male) : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, BC, EWS, PH : Rs. 500/-
  • ESM, All Females : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
